newsitem.title: JAPAN: Cosmo Oil to buy 900,000 bbl April Iraqi crude.
newsitem.headline: Cosmo Oil to buy 900,000 bbl April Iraqi crude.

text.p: Cosmo Oil Co Ltd said on Friday it had signed a contract with Iraq's State Oil Marketing Organisation (SOMO) to buy Iraqi crude for the first time in eight years.

The refiner will buy 900,000 barrels of Iraq's Basrah Light crude for April 10 to 25 loading at the Gulf port of Mina al-Bakr, at a price of five cents per barrel above the average of Oman and Dubai quotations, Cosmo Oil said in statement.
Cosmo Oil received United Nations approval for the purchase on March 19, a company spokesman said.
Iraq is currently selling oil in the second 90-day period of its six-month oil-for-food deal, which started on December 10 and will end on June 7.

Under the deal, Iraq is allowed to sell $2 billion worth of crude over six months, mainly to buy food and medicine for civilians suffering under sanctions slapped on Baghdad after it invaded Kuwait in August 1990.
Last December Mitsubishi Corp signed an agreement to buy Iraqi crude on behalf of five Japanese oil firms.
The contract is for 20,000 barrels per day over a period of six months.
